rules.title: LLM output executed as code or shell
rules.fix: Treat model output as untrusted. Never execute it; parse it into a strict schema and dispatch to an allowlist of safe operations.

rules.title: Prompt built by concatenating untrusted input into system instructions
rules.fix: Keep system prompts static; pass user input in the user role, delimit untrusted content, and enforce authorization in tools, not in the prompt.
